notablePrerequisites:
Ioreth and Forensic Researcher do not have summoning sickness.
There is another legendary creature on the battlefield.
description:
If Forensic Researcher is not your Ring-bearer, use the card that causes the Ring to tempt you to cause Forensic Researcher to become your Ring-bearer, thus making it legendary.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Forensic Researcher and another legendary creature.
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat from step 2.
